decision2-nox-4b.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
decision2-nox-4b.measurement_facts: Merged rank-128 LoRA on all text projections of Qwen3.5-4B-Base plus a new candidate head; eight-seed weight soup. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

decision2-lux-9b.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
decision2-lux-9b.measurement_facts: Full fine-tune of Decision-1.0-Lux-9B with soft targets; Qwen3.5-9B lineage. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

noma.licence: MPL-2.0 weights and code; Apache-2.0 base
noma.measurement_facts: First 18 of 32 Qwen3.5-4B-Base layers with a merged LoRA and four bootstrap-trained scorer heads. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

fastsem-jev-l16r25.licence: MIT inference code; Apache-2.0 base weights
fastsem-jev-l16r25.measurement_facts: Training-free inference method on frozen Qwen3.5-4B weights, using the author l16r25 configuration in process. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

kev-9b-v2.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
kev-9b-v2.measurement_facts: Rank-16 LoRA and pointer head; author runtime with KEV_FUSED=0 because the published serving lock omits the fused-kernel dependency. Stored head temperature retained. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

janus-35b-a3b.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
janus-35b-a3b.measurement_facts: NVFP4 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B backbone with rank-64 LoRA and pointer head, measured on Blackwell hardware required by the routed-expert kernel. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

coco-decision-4b-ko.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
coco-decision-4b-ko.measurement_facts: Korean/English rank-16 LoRA served unmerged by the author oh-my-jev engine. The 96 GB card used bf16; the engine's optional nf4 fallback did not trigger. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

reflex-reason-2b.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
reflex-reason-2b.measurement_facts: Pinned Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct adapter and decision head, served by the author runtime. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

decision2-vega-27b.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
decision2-vega-27b.measurement_facts: Rank-64 LoRA and candidate head on the pinned Qwen3.8-27B backbone; base is loaded separately. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

decision2-sol-2b.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
decision2-sol-2b.measurement_facts: Full fine-tune of Decision-1.0-Sol-2B with soft targets; Qwen3.5-2B lineage. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

decision2-eos-0.8b.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
decision2-eos-0.8b.measurement_facts: Full fine-tune of Decision-1.0-Eos-0.8B, itself a Qwen3.5-0.8B fine-tune. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

kev-27b-v2.measurement_facts: Full merged bf16 checkpoint and pointer head; author runtime with KEV_FUSED=0. Stored head temperature retained. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

janus-08b-gpu.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence

decision2-kai-0.6b.measurement_facts: Full fine-tune of Qwen3-0.6B-Base with a candidate head trained from scratch; six-checkpoint weight average. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

jevberta-base.measurement_facts: 198M DeBERTa-v3-base encoder with two candidate-set attention layers and an MLP scoring head. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

reflex-instinct-06b.measurement_facts: Pinned Qwen3-0.6B adapter and decision head, served by the author runtime. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.

tachyone-en.licence: Apache-2.0 weights and code; base retains its own Apache-2.0 licence
tachyone-en.measurement_facts: Author CPU backend on shared AMD Zen 2 hardware (6 cores / 12 threads, AVX2). Recorded CPU load makes Speed a disclosed lower bound; no CUDA fast path was enabled. Self-hosted; serial, one decision per request. Original ×2 + 0.15 s latency adjustment retained.
